items.source: Server-side support for SockJS transports including TransportHandler implementations for processing incoming requests, their session counterparts for sending messages over the various transports, and DefaultSockJsService.
items.translation: 服务器端支持 SockJS 传输，包括用于处理传入请求的 TransportHandler 实现、用于通过各种传输发送消息的其 session 对应对象，以及 DefaultSockJsService。

items.source: A default implementation of SockJsService with all default TransportHandler implementations pre-registered.
items.translation: 带有所有默认TransportHandler实现预注册的SockJsService的默认实现。

items.source: Uses of SockJsServiceConfig in org.springframework.web.socket.sockjs.transport
items.translation: `SockJsServiceConfig` 接口在 `org.springframework.web.socket.sockjs.transport` 包中的用法

items.source: Uses of SockJsServiceConfig in org.springframework.web.socket.sockjs.transport.handler
items.translation: `SockJsServiceConfig` 接口在 `org.springframework.web.socket.sockjs.transport.handler` 包中的使用

items.source: Uses of SockJsServiceConfig in org.springframework.web.socket.sockjs.transport.session
items.translation: 在 `org.springframework.web.socket.sockjs.transport.session` 包中 `SockJsServiceConfig` 的用法

items.source: TransportHandler implementation classes as well as a concrete SockJsService.
items.translation: `TransportHandler` 实现类以及具体的 `SockJsService`。

items.source: SockJS specific implementations of WebSocketSession.
items.translation: SockJS 特定的 WebSocketSession 实现。

items.source: A basic implementation of SockJsService with support for SPI-based transport handling and session management.
items.translation: 一个基本的SockJsService实现，支持基于 SPI 的传输处理和会话管理。

items.source: Initialize this handler with the given configuration.
items.translation: 使用给定配置初始化此处理器。
